newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain gvt to study today liberalisation package.
newsitem.headline: Spain gvt to study today liberalisation package.

text.p: The Spanish cabinet will study a package of liberalisation measures on Friday aimed at helping economic growth, a government source said.
The measures are largely concerned with the telecommunications, property and energy sectors, the source said on Friday.
The government may also give the go-ahead for new financing instruments aimed at small- and medium-sized companies and incentives to encourage savings.
The package is aimed at fuelling investor confidence in Spain, Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Thursday.
"The measures, overall, will give a new fillip to the modernisation of Spain's means of production promoting more market confidence vis a vis Spain's integration in monetary union," Montoro said.
